slots.name: Whirlpool Spin
slots.description: Tuck into your shell and spin once, splashing fighters around you before popping back out.

slots.name: Air Whirlpool Spin
slots.description: Spin in your shell while carrying your airborne momentum, then pop out and fall.

slots.name: Shell Flip
slots.description: Tuck into your shell and somersault backward to launch an opponent upward, then settle on the same spot.

slots.name: Air Shell Flip
slots.description: Tuck into your shell and somersault backward in the air to launch an opponent upward, carrying your airborne momentum.

slots.name: Rising Shell
slots.description: Tuck into your shell, strike diagonally forward and up, then pull back and land on the same spot.

slots.name: Air Diagonal Shell
slots.description: Strike forward and up from your shell while carrying airborne momentum, then unfold back into falling.

slots.name: Rescue Ring
slots.description: Throw your life ring straight at your target. The first fighter it meets is reeled in to your feet, stuck just long enough for one normal. A miss, a wall or a shield means reeling the empty ring back.

slots.name: Hydro Jet
slots.description: Tuck and jet off in the stick's direction with no wind-up (neutral goes straight up). The jet behind you shoves. Press R mid-jet to dive without untucking; landing tucked splashes.

slots.name: Cannonball
slots.description: Hop up tucked and cannonball onto where your target stood. The splash launches everyone around upward, into your normals. If they moved, you pop up out of the splash open to a punish.

slots.name: Cannonball Dive
slots.description: Tuck and dive steeply at the ground ahead, leaning toward a target in front. Landing splashes like the Cannonball. Pressed during Hydro Jet it keeps the jet's speed.

slots.name: Wave Pool
slots.description: Blow your whistle: a wave rises behind you and you ride it in your shell toward your target, carrying everyone it meets toward the edge, shields and all. It breaks at the lip. Jump off to send them flying into your aerial.
